functions.does: The steering wheel steers the front wheels: an 8-tooth gear at the foot of the steering column slides the steering rack across, and the rack's ends swing the two steering arms.
functions.source: book: steps 3-4 (steering arms on axle pins), 8 (rack), 9 (column and 8-tooth gear), 10 (steering wheel); the cover blueprint draws a turning arrow on the steering wheel

functions.does: Pushing the kart along works its engine: the crank on the rear axle on the engine's side drives a connecting rod that pumps the piston up and down in the cylinder behind the seat.
functions.source: book: steps 3 (crank and connecting rod on the 4-long rear axle, inset), 5 (cylinder and piston), 10 (wheels)
functions.note: the other rear wheel is on its own axle and doesn't drive the engine

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely: each rear wheel on its own 4-long axle, each front wheel on its steering arm's axle.
The number board at the front tilts on its hinge.
